svg.aria-label: Example: G(s) = 4/((s − 1)(s/2 + 1)(s/3 + 1)) has one unstable pole, so only the first case applies and the plot must encircle the disk once anticlockwise. A small disk centred at −3.2 inside the left lobe, of radius 0.16, works: absolute stability for the sector [0.298, 0.329]
